findings.title: Expired spending leases can restart without the required checkpoint
findings.detail: FIXED. The takeover guard rejects checkpoint-free MODEL_TASK/JOB_ATTEMPT resumes and requires exact stored-checkpoint equality. claim_lease checks expiry before owner identity at line 260 and advances every expired claim's fence at line 280. Checked adapter regressions at packages/persistence/test/adapters-leases.test.ts:123 and :158 and direct SQL enforcement at packages/persistence/test/journals-leases.test.ts:335. Their passes appear in verify.log:403, :404 and :518.
findings.reproduction: The cited tests attempt another owner's takeover without any stored checkpoint and the original owner's expired re-claim with missing or incorrect checkpoints. Each is refused without changing the lease. A valid stored checkpoint resumes under fence 2 and fences out fence 1.

findings.title: ApprovePlan accepts sources whose retention has already expired
findings.detail: FIXED. The handler rejects null source availability. packages/persistence/src/repositories/workspace.ts:327 computes availability after the revision transition lock using ACTIVE retention records whose effective_deadline exceeds kauro.server_now(). Checked apps/api/test/cmd025-approve-plan.test.ts:240, which independently establishes lapsed retention, asserts SOURCE_EXPIRED and unchanged state, and includes a current-source positive control. The positive approval test independently checks retention at line 78. Both pass in verify.log:829 and :831.
findings.reproduction: A source sealed fifteen days earlier remains SEALED with an ACTIVE but lapsed retention record and no sweeper run. Approval returns 422 SOURCE_EXPIRED, leaves the plan VALIDATED v4 and writes no approval, approval transition event or journal. A current source returns 201.
